label: Current mismatch in a mirror
subgoals: Treat the threshold difference as a gate-voltage error
Multiply by gm over Id to get relative current mismatch
Choose low gm over Id for current sources and high for input pairs

label: Adding independent contributions
subgoals: Write each independent contribution as a variance
Add the variances and take the square root
Target the largest term in the budget

label: Input-referred offset of an OTA
subgoals: Refer the load mismatch to the input through gm3 over gm1
Add the input-pair and load contributions in variance
Lower the load gm relative to the input pair to cut offset
